definition: to break on the surface without falling apart
description: A woman in a cream fleece jacket, white trousers and a cream beanie walks across the glassy black ice of a frozen lake, her reflection sharp beneath her feet. She opens a steel thermos, unscrews the cup, and pours steaming dark tea onto the ice. The hot liquid spreads across the surface and stains it brown. The camera looks straight down as fine white lines shoot out from the spot in every direction, until the ice is covered by a wide star of cracks under her feet.

taps.phrase: to crouch on the frozen lake
